purpose: Represent the private SATA engineering economy where agents use internal SATA accounting to allocate compute, pay for delegated work, verify outcomes, and conserve tokens.

layers.label: Engineering Mind
layers.role: Strategy, task allocation, verification, learning, and governance.
layers.authority: Can allocate private work budgets and evaluate outcomes; cannot move assets.

layers.label: Specialized Agents
layers.role: Domain agents execute tasks and settle private SATA accounting entries with evidence.

agents.label: GMGN Agent
agents.purpose: Market and route research tasks inside the private compute economy.

agents.label: Micronaut Agent
agents.purpose: Implementation, testing, and code-review tasks inside the private compute economy.

agents.label: Career Agent
agents.purpose: External opportunity, relationship, and operating-support tasks inside the private compute economy.

layers.label: SATA_RESERVE
layers.role: Compute treasury, private accounting ledger, budget allocation, settlement, and evidence retention.

layers.label: Compute Providers
layers.role: Codex sessions, model inference, tool execution, tests, and other measurable compute inputs.
layers.budgetSource: GitHub Pro subscription and chairman-approved compute budget.

efficiencyRules: Prefer reuse of existing validated artifacts before spending new compute.
Charge private SATA to the requesting agent when delegated work consumes meaningful compute.
Pay evidence bonuses for artifacts that reduce future token usage.
Apply rework penalties for avoidable duplication, missing evidence, or unsupported claims.
Do not treat private SATA balances as public token balances or market value.
nextAction: Record the first real private agent-to-agent task quote using this architecture and the agent-sata-ledger schema.
